summary: Short, steep kerb at a junction corner under No Stopping signs.

drivers.seclusion: Carport 8 m and detached house 12 m from the kerb; homes close on the same side.
drivers.access_and_room: Twelve-metre kerb at a junction corner; no room for a van clear of the traffic lane.
drivers.traffic: Corner of Ward Street and Fairley Street with turning traffic.
drivers.convention: Several No Stopping Any Time signs and 1/4P school-day signs; no cars parked.

flags: No Stopping Any Time signs at the corner
sun_shade: Trees shade the western end; open to the east and south.
